notes.title: 「Kirakira stars idol project Reika」Pre-trial version available!
notes.content:
To coincide with the Game Festival Autumn 2020
「Kirakira stars idol project Reika」 is now available as an advance trial version!

You can play the first chapter of this game.
If you'd like, please play it at least once.
Also, we've added character voices, so enjoy the cute voices of each character!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396050/Kirakira_stars_idol_project_Reika/

Added on 10/12
English translation has been added to the advance trial version!

*Please note that there is a possibility that the translation may change from the full version.

Thank you very much for your continued support of "Sushi soft".

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello!
It is "sushi soft" support.

For more information, please visit the "Sushi soft" website.

notes.title: It is an announcement of the update about the defect.
notes.content:
Hello!
"sushi soft" support.

We have made a correction for the bug that is currently occurring in the game, so we will contact you.

Bug fixes:

- Fixed that it can be reacquired every time the achievement is started
- Achievements "Whaaa?!" Fixed not being able to get
- Fixed in-game notifications when achievements are acquired
-Fixed some errors in the translation of "Simplified Chinese" with respect to choices
-Fixed part of the translation of "Simplified Chinese" for translations around the config because it was "Traditional Chinese"
Please adapt the update before you play the game.

We will contact you if there are any defect fixes or updates in the future.

Thank you for "sushi soft" in the future.
